name: cloud-guardian
description: Explore cloud costs and Vercel billing in Codex, with provider onboarding, project mentions, and scoped remediation workflows.

interface.longDescription: Open the cloud cost overview, inspect saved infrastructure, and reference connected projects in chat. Explore Vercel billed and effective costs with your existing local Vercel CLI login, without a Cloud Guardian account connection. Bundled skills guide provider onboarding and evidence-based cost reviews. Cloud changes use scoped remediation tools.
defaultPrompt: Set up Cloud Guardian and connect my cloud account.
Open my cloud cost overview and explain the largest costs.
Review this project's costs and prepare a remediation plan.
